company-history.title: Protection Begins With Better Packaging.
company-history.firstParagraph: At AAVRIT Packaging, we believe packaging is more than just a box. It is an essential part of protecting products, maintaining quality and helping businesses deliver with confidence.
company-history.secondParagraph: From customized corrugated boxes to dependable bulk packaging solutions, our focus is on understanding business requirements and creating packaging that combines strength, practicality and value.

growth-journey.title: Our Journey & Manufacturing Milestones.
growth-journey.subtitle: From our foundational corrugation lines in 2008 to modern high-speed automated facilities, explore every stage that shaped our quality packaging journey.

milestones.headline: Foundations of Quality Packaging
milestones.description: Aavrit Packaging started in 2008 with a simple ambition: to manufacture dependable, high-integrity corrugated cartons tailored to the essential protection requirements of local industries while building genuine relationships with every client.
milestones.keyHighlight: Manual corrugation lines & foundational quality standards

milestones.headline: Scaling Production & Infrastructure
milestones.description: Expanded plant footprint and introduced semi-automated flute laminating lines, enabling steady delivery of 3-ply and 5-ply cartons across emerging FMCG, engineering, and automotive component sectors.

milestones.headline: High-Speed Automated Corrugation
milestones.description: Invested in continuous high-speed corrugators, multi-color rotary die-cutters, and stringent in-house bursting strength QA testing units for high-volume commercial clients.
milestones.keyHighlight: Continuous corrugator line & multi-color flexo printing

milestones.headline: Sustainable Engineering & Pan-India Reach
milestones.description: Today, Aavrit Packaging leads with 100% recyclable virgin and test kraft engineering, serving over 500 enterprise clients with dependable, precision-engineered corrugated packaging across India.

working-principles.title: The Principles Behind Every Box We Create.
working-principles.subtitle: Our approach brings together thoughtful manufacturing, customer-focused solutions and a consistent commitment to quality.

principles.label: OUR PRODUCTION PHILOSOPHY
principles.heading: Thoughtful Manufacturing. Practical Solutions.
principles.description: We believe good packaging begins with understanding the product and its requirements. Our production approach focuses on thoughtful design, suitable material selection and careful manufacturing practices to create practical corrugated packaging solutions.
bulletPoints: Optimal flute geometry matched to load-bearing dynamics
Sustainable kraft paperboard sourcing with high tensile strength
Resource-efficient die-cutting and precise slotting operations
principles.imageAlt: Corrugated cardboard manufacturing machinery fluting raw kraft paper in modern plant

principles.label: OUR CUSTOMER APPROACH
principles.heading: Understanding Needs. Building Relationships.
principles.description: Every packaging requirement is different. We value clear communication, understanding customer expectations and working towards suitable packaging solutions for different products and applications.
bulletPoints: Transparent recommendations tailored to transit environments
Responsive turnaround on customized box specifications
principles.imageAlt: Packaging consultation worktable with kraft box prototypes, calipers, and technical plans

principles.label: OUR QUALITY COMMITMENT
principles.heading: Attention to Detail at Every Stage.
principles.description: We recognize the importance of packaging consistency and product protection. Our approach emphasizes attention to materials, dimensions, construction and inspection according to the requirements of each packaging solution.
bulletPoints: Uniform scoring and accurate 90° fold integrity
Edge crush and bursting strength awareness across batches
Dimensional adherence to prevent transit shifting and product damage
principles.imageAlt: Quality inspection workstation checking corrugated flute layers, fold edges, and box thickness

about-faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
about-faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our company, packaging solutions and manufacturing approach.

faqs.q: What does our company specialize in?
faqs.a: We specialize in corrugated cardboard packaging solutions designed for different product types, packaging requirements and business applications.

faqs.q: What types of packaging solutions do we offer?
faqs.a: We offer corrugated packaging solutions for different applications, including shipping cartons, industrial packaging and customized boxes. Specific options depend on our manufacturing capabilities.

faqs.q: Can we provide customized packaging solutions?
faqs.a: Yes. Packaging requirements can be discussed based on product dimensions, intended application, packaging style and other project requirements.

faqs.q: How do we approach manufacturing quality?
faqs.a: Our approach focuses on suitable material selection, careful manufacturing practices and attention to dimensions, construction and packaging requirements.
Our packaging solutions are intended for applications across industries such as automotive, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, e-commerce, electronics, textiles, agriculture and engineering.
